profile.name: Angelo James
profile.title: Mechanical Engineering Student
profile.bio: I am an aspiring mechanical engineer with a passion for robotics, 3D printing, and industrial design. My portfolio showcases hands-on experience in CAD design, programming, and technical problem-solving through various personal, academic, and competitive robotics projects.

projects.title: Zero-G-Hydra
projects.description: Printer build focused on advanced motion system upgrades, structural rigidity, and precision improvements to enhance speed, stability, and overall 3D printing performance.

projects.title: Voron V0.2900
projects.description: Built a compact high-performance 3D printer platform emphasizing precision, speed, and reliability through advanced motion systems and custom assembly.

projects.title: FTC Coaxial Swerve
projects.description: Designed a compact holonomic drivetrain combining steering and drive in a single axis, improving maneuverability, control precision, and mechanical efficiency for competition robotics.

projects.title: CrabCrawler (Robotic Eye)
projects.description: Developed a robotic eye system focused on servo-controlled movement and synchronization to create expressive, responsive behavior for interactive robotics and human-machine interaction.

projects.title: Delta Printer
projects.description: Delta printer build and experience focused on precision motion systems, calibration, and rapid prototyping using a kinematics-based 3D printing design for high speed and smooth operation.

projects.title: AI Chatbot
projects.description: Project focused on building conversational systems with speech interaction, natural language processing, and hardware integration to create responsive and interactive user experiences.
